title: no-js-filter-table: filter and sort a server-rendered HTML table
description:
A small, dependency-free script that filters and sorts a server-rendered HTML table. Every row stays in the page's HTML, so the table works with JavaScript off and search engines can read it; with the script, the form filters rows in place and keeps the filters in the URL.

It powers the free Protein Finder: https://health.dailyappslab.com/macroscout/protein-finder/
